Hello, everyone!

I'm Dr. Holden Stanfill, and I'm the proud owner of Stanfill Chiropractic and Rehabilitation. My passion is assisting individuals in overcoming common issues such as low back pain, neck discomfort, persistent headaches, and sciatica. At our practice, we specialize in addressing a wide range of muscle and joint problems.

We're dedicated to providing a comprehensive range of treatments tailored to your unique needs. Our services include precise adjustments, rehabilitation, Y-Strap adjustments, decompression therapy, soothing massage sessions, and instrument-assisted soft tissue techniques, among others.

Join me on this journey towards optimal health and well-being, and let's work together to achieve a pain-free, vibrant life. Subscribe to my channel to stay updated on valuable insights and tips for a healthier you!

Give us a call to schedule your appointment or book online on our website!
